# HEVN: Brex for Non-US Internet Companies

Operate in USD — without needing a US entity.

Peter Volnov

HEVN, inc

HEVN: Brex for non-US companies

\\Tl;Dr;\\  
 Banking for non-US internet companies is hard. HEVN provides an alternative: open virtual bank accounts in 1 day, get USD cards with 0% FX, and send/receive ACH, SEPA, wires, and USDC.

The problem

For non-US companies, USD banking takes months, requires travel, and often breaks after the first transactions — making it hard to get paid via Stripe, Apple, or run global payroll.

In practice: [...] In practice:

 2-20 weeks to open an account in UAE or Hong Kong
 Founders have to fly in-person just to pass KYC
 $20K+ per year in legal and banking fees
 Accounts get frozen after first SWIFT transfer
 Visa charge 2-3% FX fee on USD payments

At the same time, Brex, Ramp, and Mercury only support US companies with an EIN.

What HEVN does

HEVN is a B2B financial platform that lets global internet companies operate in USD — without needing a US entity.

 Run your business in USD with corporate cards and global payments with 0% FX fees
 Get named local accounts in EU, US, HK and UAE banks in 1 day
 Send and receive ACH / SEPA / USDC / wires worldwide
 (soon) Store USD in FDIC-insured US accounts, even without an EIN

Hi Product Hunt! 👋 We built HEVN U.S. Accounts after seeing international businesses lose days to bank emails, manual paperwork, unclear transfer statuses, and failed USD payments. For importers, exporters, commodity traders, and manufacturers, a delayed payment can hold up an entire shipment. Global trade moves continuously, but traditional banking often does not. HEVN gives eligible companies in 100+ countries access to USD accounts through U.S. sponsor banks. Businesses can hold USD, receive payments via Fedwire, pay U.S. counterparties locally, and settle supported international payments from one platform. We would love your feedback. What is the biggest friction your company faces when moving USD internationally?
